'''Guidenhauser''' was a manufacturing company that produced [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejection seats]]. [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] included a crash-worthy Guidenhauser ejection seat as standard.<ref name="SWS" />
